definitions.explanation: Describes a child who is energetically disobedient, playfully unruly, or boisterously active. Generally carries an affectionate or tolerant nuance rather than true disapproval.

examples.japanese: わんぱくな⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧だ。
うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わんぱく⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: Our son is so mischievous, it's a handful.

examples.japanese: わんぱくな⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泥|どろ}だらけ→泥だらけ：15076_dorodarake⟧になって⟦{遊|あそ}んでいた→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The rambunctious boys were playing in the park, covered in mud.

notes:
Also written in kanji as {腕白|わんぱく}, though the hiragana or katakana spelling is more common today. Typically used to describe boys, though it can apply to any energetically mischievous child. The word has a warm, almost nostalgic tone — it suggests healthy, spirited playfulness rather than malicious behavior.

USAGE:
Functions as a na-adjective (わんぱくな⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧) or as a noun (わんぱく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧, わんぱく⟦{坊主|ぼうず}→坊主：10119_bouzu⟧). Almost exclusively used for children — using it for adults would sound odd or deliberately humorous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- わんぱくな⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧: a mischievous child
- わんぱく{盛|ざか}り: at the peak of mischievous age
- わんぱく⟦{坊主|ぼうず}→坊主：10119_bouzu⟧: mischievous little boy
- わんぱくな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: a rambunctious personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いたずらっ{子|こ}: prankster, naughty child — focuses on playing tricks rather than general rowdiness
- ⟦やんちゃ→やんちゃ：09359_yancha⟧な: unruly, rowdy — very similar but slightly more modern and casual
- ⟦{生意気|なまいき}→生意気：08271_namaiki⟧な: cheeky, impudent — more negative, implies rudeness or talking back
